verdict.rationale: Kitty documents and ships a dedicated Terminal Graphics Protocol allowing clients to render arbitrary pixel graphics inline, plus the icat kitten for displaying images, corroborated by community praise ('The diff and icat tools are must-haves'). This is a well-documented, first-party protocol spec, not just a claim. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification specifically of the graphics protocol (probe evidence only covers remote-control, not icat/graphics rendering).
